title: The Shop page shows only the newest 300 orders, so its Collected, Cancelled and All counts stop growing
what: The server hands the admin app only the newest 300 shop orders. The Shop page counts New, Ready, Collected, Cancelled and All from that list, so once a gym passes 300 orders the counts freeze near 300 and older orders disappear from the All tab with no note and no way to see them. A busy gym of 500 members ordering a shake now and then gets there in a few months.
expected: The counts are the real totals, and older orders can still be looked up (a Show older button or a date pick).
who: owners and desk staff of busy shops
how_often: every time, once a gym has over 300 orders
fix_line: Count totals on the server and let the page fetch older orders on request

title: Every open admin screen downloads the newest 300 shop orders again every minute
what: Whatever screen the owner or desk has open, the admin app re-reads the newest 300 shop orders, with every line of each order, once a minute while the tab is in view, only to see whether anything is new. On a desk phone on mobile data this is a steady download all day, most of it orders that have not changed.
expected: The app asks only for orders new or changed since its last look, so an idle minute costs almost nothing.
who: every gym with the member app on
how_often: every minute the admin app is in view
fix_line: Ask the server only for orders changed since the last read

title: The list of members in the app is downloaded whole by three screens on their own, and redrawn the slow way
what: The full list of everyone who joined the gym in the app, with their order counts, has no paging. The Joined in the app list reads it every minute, the Messages page every 2 minutes, and the Today page every 5 minutes for the birthday wish, even when that reminder is off. On the Joined list each row is matched against the gym's whole member list by mobile number, and this is redone on every redraw, at least every 30 seconds: with 500 in the app and 800 on the books that is about 400,000 number clean-ups each time on a cheap desk phone.
expected: One shared copy of the list, read only when needed, and a page of 50 at a time; the mobile-number match is worked out once per change.
who: gyms with many members in the app
how_often: every minute a list screen is open
fix_line: Keep one shared app-member list, page it, and build the mobile lookup once

items.reason: no admin-app page in the speed scores (it needs a sign-in); every shop screen (Shop, Invite, check-in poster, Messages, offers, reminders) is loaded up front with the rest of the app, which is the existing first-download finding; product photos load lazily and are shrunk to 1000 px before upload
admin-app shop and member-app settings screens only; no phone app start or workout screen here
no watch code in this area

the lists these screens read (orders, products, app members, sent messages, seen counts, plan and report requests, trainer questions, web push, photo tickets) all filter on indexed columns; the advisor's unindexed links here (message seen by member, requests by app member, web push by staff) are only walked when a gym or staff row is removed, and app members are never deleted; photo tickets are cleared every call so stay tiny
